# Animation dependencies

GSAP core and ScrollTrigger **3.15.0**, copied from the installed `gsap`
package, without modification. Both bundles retain their copyright and
license notices. No CDN is required for the cinematic sequence.

Source: https://gsap.com/ — https://gsap.com/standard-license

Only core and ScrollTrigger are shipped; no smooth-scroll engine or 3D library.
